prompt: Fetch http://127.0.0.1:{port}/users and http://127.0.0.1:{port}/orders (both return JSON with a `count` field). Write one line to summary.txt in exactly this form: users=<count> orders=<count>

verify.command: test "$(cat summary.txt | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 'users=42orders=17' || test "$(tr -s ' \n' ' ' < summary.txt | sed 's/ *$//')" = 'users=42 orders=17'
